review.scope: Release 3.2 of payments-api; the admin console is reviewed separately.
review.subject: payments-api (JSON API behind the public gateway)

results.title: Enforce server-side object authorization
Validate untrusted input at boundaries
evidence: Request bodies are parsed by pydantic models in src/payments/schemas.py.
tests/test_input.py covers oversize amounts and unknown currency codes.

results.title: Prevent injection into interpreters and queries
evidence: All queries go through SQLAlchemy Core with bound parameters; no raw SQL strings.
Semgrep python.sqlalchemy rules run in CI with no open findings.

results.title: Restrict user-influenced outbound requests
evidence: Outbound calls go only to the card processor, whose host is fixed in config.

results.title: Enforce strong authentication and session integrity
evidence: Authentication is delegated to the gateway; the service verifies the signed JWT.
tests/test_auth.py rejects expired, unsigned, and wrong-audience tokens.

results.title: Keep secrets out of code, logs, and rules
evidence: Processor credentials come from the secrets manager at start-up.
Gitleaks runs on every pull request with no findings.

results.title: Harden file upload and file path handling
results.notes: The service accepts no uploads and reads no paths derived from input.

results.title: Log security events without leaking sensitive data
results.notes: Refund failures log the full processor response, which includes the card holder name.

results.title: Manage known-vulnerable and unmaintained dependencies
evidence: Dependabot and pip-audit run weekly; the lock file has no known-vulnerable pins.

results.title: Apply secure defaults and remove risky configuration
evidence: Debug mode is off in the production image; the settings test asserts it.

results.title: Harden session cookies and session lifecycle
results.notes: The service is stateless; sessions live in the gateway.

results.title: Encode output to prevent cross-site scripting
results.notes: The service returns JSON only and renders no HTML.

results.title: Protect state-changing requests against CSRF
results.notes: Clients authenticate with bearer tokens, not cookies.

results.title: Avoid user and account enumeration
evidence: Unknown and foreign payment ids both return the same 404 body.

results.title: Verify authenticity of inbound webhooks and signed messages
evidence: Processor webhooks are verified with HMAC and a five-minute timestamp window.
tests/test_webhooks.py rejects bad signatures and replayed events.

results.title: Return only the minimum required data
evidence: Responses are built from explicit response models; card numbers are masked.

results.title: Allowlist fields bound from request input
evidence: Update endpoints accept only the fields declared in their request models.

results.title: Validate redirect destinations against an allowlist
Apply rate limiting and resource quotas

exception.compensating_control: Gateway limit of 50 requests per second and an alert on 429 spikes.
exception.justification: The gateway applies a global request limit; per-client quotas need a new store.

results.notes: Per-client limits are planned for release 3.3.

results.title: Store passwords with an adaptive password hashing function
results.notes: The service stores no passwords; users authenticate at the gateway.

issues.message: a met rule must cite at least one piece of evidence
